title: Why did some Apollo missions carry a grenade launcher? (2019)
why_read: A quirky bit of space history trivia about Apollo mission equipment that is entertaining but not deeply technical.
analysis: This 2019 article likely explains that some Apollo lunar missions carried a modified grenade launcher as part of a seismic experiment package, used to create controlled explosions for studying the Moon's subsurface via seismometers. It is a neat piece of space engineering history showing how instruments were repurposed for scientific data collection rather than combat. The technical content is light but the historical context around planetary seismology equipment is genuinely interesting for space enthusiasts.
